note: Test cases Constellate wrote for imported skills that arrived with none, so they can be trialled. Each expected answer is stated in the skill's own text; 'from' quotes the line it comes from. Checked with the exact verifier (the answer's last word). Keyed by repository:path, as in data/seed/agent-skills.json.

saorsa-labs/x0x:SKILL.md.input: Which x0x CLI command starts the default daemon? Answer with the subcommand only, as the last word.
saorsa-labs/x0x:SKILL.md.from: x0x start                   # start the default daemon

saorsa-labs/x0x:SKILL.md.input: x0x agent and machine IDs are SHA-256 hashes of public keys from which signature scheme? Answer with its name only, as the last word.
saorsa-labs/x0x:SKILL.md.from: All IDs are 32-byte SHA-256 hashes of ML-DSA-65 public keys

saorsa-labs/x0x:SKILL.md.input: Which x0x daemon route reports health without a bearer token? Answer with the route only, with its leading slash, as the last word.

WithAutonomi/ant-sdk:skill.md.input: Which file does the antd daemon write so SDKs can discover its port? Answer with the file name only, as the last word.
WithAutonomi/ant-sdk:skill.md.from: antd writes `daemon.port` to the platform data dir

WithAutonomi/ant-sdk:skill.md.input: When discovery fails, which localhost port does antd's REST API fall back to? Answer with the number only, as the last word.
WithAutonomi/ant-sdk:skill.md.from: Default fallback: REST on `localhost:8082`, gRPC on `localhost:50051`.

WithAutonomi/ant-sdk:skill.md.input: Which antd version is the first with pointers? Answer with the version number only, as the last word.
WithAutonomi/ant-sdk:skill.md.from: Needs antd 0.16.0 or later (the first release with pointers).
